fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-07-29, the complainant paid Rs. 45,000 for an item advertised on a social media page, but the item never arrived and the seller stopped responding. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-07-28 at about 12:55. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Venkat Palanisamy, using the number 9000000134. Vasanth Mani (9000000382) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The complaint refers to Udhay Muthu, an intermediary, reachable on 9000000352. Items referenced in the complaint: social media screenshots.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim reportedly paid in advance and was blocked by the seller.
fields.Keywords: online shopping fraud, fake seller, witness, associate, screenshot, suspect, afternoon, apartment complex
